summary: Vista Energy, S.A.B. de C.V., a Mexican oil and gas issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a share repurchase executed on July 31, 2026. The company bought back 50,000 Series A shares at MXN 1,215.85 per share, totaling approximately MXN 60.8 million, excluding fees and VAT. The buyback was authorized at the April 28, 2026 ordinary shareholders' meeting. After the repurchase, 111,117,402 Series A shares remain outstanding and 1,184,351 shares are held in treasury. Citi México Casa de Bolsa executed the transactions. This is a routine capital return disclosure; watch for continued buyback execution under the existing authorization.
